name: plugin.codebase_context
description: Multi-layer codebase context architecture, token budgeting, SSOT synchronization, and 5-stage context governance
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: context_lint
entrypoints.description: Verify repository context files across token budgets, path integrity, manifest scripts, and sync drift

entrypoints.name: context_sync
entrypoints.description: Synchronize downstream vendor context files (CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md) against canonical SSOT

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, check for sync drift without modifying disk files

entrypoints.name: context_govern
entrypoints.description: Execute complete 5-stage context governance cycle and dynamic 5D compute tier assessment

parameters.name: complexity
parameters.description: Estimated 5D repository complexity score between 0.0 and 1.0
